closure.source: fun make(n) { fun add(v) { n = n + v; return n; } return add; } var f = make(2); print f(3); print f(4);

super_native.source: class A { init(n) { this.n = n; } value() { clock(); return this.n; } } class B < A { value() { return super.value() + 1; } } var b = B(6); var bound = b.value; print bound();
